questions.question: India’s first open-sea marine fish farming project as part of the Blue Economy initiative in the Andaman Sea. This project was was implemented through collaboration between which two entities?

National Institute of Ocean Technology and Andaman & Nicobar Administration
Indian Council of Agricultural Research and Ministry of Earth Sciences

• The National Institute of Ocean Technology developed specialized open-sea cages used for finfish farming.
 
• The Andaman & Nicobar Administration facilitated regional implementation and coordination.
 
• The collaboration aims to unlock marine resources and enhance livelihoods of fishing communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __
 
• The local administrative authority governing the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• Plays a key role in implementing central initiatives at the regional level.

 __
 
• Refers to the cultivation of fish species with fins, such as seabass and cobia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **China imposed a 13% value-added tax on condoms and contraceptive pills from January 1, 2026.**
 
• The tax exemption had been in place for nearly 30 years.
 
• The move aims to address China’s declining birth rate.
 
• China’s population fell for the third consecutive year in 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Demographic Context__

 __
 
• China has experienced falling birth rates for decades.
 
• Decline attributed to the former one-child policy, urbanisation and rising living costs.
 
• High childcare and education expenses discourage family formation.
 
 
 
• Government Measures__
 __
 
• Childcare subsidies exempted from personal income tax.
 
• Annual childcare subsidy introduced in 2024.
 
• Promotion of positive marriage and childbearing attitudes through policy messaging.
 
 
 
• Policy Significance__
 
 
• Reflects China’s shift towards fertility-friendly economic policies.
 
• Part of broader efforts announced at the Central Economic Work Conference.
 
• Aims to stabilise population decline in the long term.

questions.question: What was the theme of the 77th Republic Day of India parade in 2026?

options.text: Amrit Kaal: The Rise of Bharat

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**150 years of Vande Mataram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Republic Day Celebrations 2026 at Kartavya Path on January 26, 2026, **were announced** to be a unique blend of **150 years of the national song ‘Vande Mataram’**, India’s military might, and cultural diversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **150 years of Vande Mataram was chosen as the central theme of the parade. A series of paintings created by Shri Tejendra Kumar Mitra in 1923, illustrating the verses of ‘Vande Mataram’, were selected to be displayed as view-cutters along Kartavya Path.**
 
• A banner depicting ‘Vande Mataram’ **was planned** to be unveiled along with the release of rubber balloons at the conclusion of the parade, and floral decorations in front of the rostrum **were designed** to follow this theme.
 
• Pan-India band performances on the theme ‘Vande Mataram’ **were scheduled** to be organized from January 19 to 26, 2026, including venues like the ancestral home of Rishi Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay at Naihati, West Bengal.
 
• The Tableaux **were designated** to be presented under the broader themes **“Swatantrata ka Mantra – Vande Mataram”** and **“Samriddhi ka Mantra – Atmanirbhar Bharat”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chief Guests**__

 __
 
• President of the European Council **Mr. Antonio Costa** and President of the European Commission **Ursula von der Leyen** **were invited** as the Chief Guests for the Republic Day Parade 2026.
 
 
 
• **Military Display**__
 __
 
• The Indian Army **was set** to showcase a **Battle Array Formation** for the first time.
 
• The parade **was scheduled** to feature a Mounted Column of 61 Cavalry and various mechanized columns including T-90 and Main Battle Tank Arjun.
 
 
 
• **Tableaux and Guests**__
 __
 
• A total of **30 Tableaux** (17 from States/UTs and 13 from Ministries/Departments/Services) **were selected** to roll down Kartavya Path.
 
• Around **10,000 Special Guests** from various walks of life, including beneficiaries of schemes like PM SMILE and PM Vishwakarma, **were identified and invited**.
 
 
 
• **Fly-past**__
 
 
• A total of 29 Aircraft of the Armed forces **were confirmed** to participate in various formations, including Rafale, Su-30, and Apache helicopters.
